verdict.rationale: First-party material positions Brex as a unified platform covering corporate cards, expense management, reimbursements, travel and bill pay, plus banking via a Brex business account. A Payments API for ACH, wires and checks backs this up, and a community user reports running "cash/cards" through Brex together. Community onboarding reports show eligibility limits for small or non-VC founders and one case requiring an external bank account at signup; these temper the claim but do not contradict the consolidated capability. Missing for 10: independent hands-on confirmation that founders actually retired separate spend, bill pay and banking tools; clarity on eligibility for small, non-VC-backed startups; in-depth docs on how banking and bill pay interoperate within one workflow.
